projects.name: yolo-stack
projects.notes: ADR 0003 (2026-11-05, docs/decisions/0003-verdict-leptos-dioxus-tanstack.md): Leptos 0.8 SSR + islands on Axum for the SEO site, Dioxus 0.8 for native, @yolo-rs/fullstack as the Next migration bridge only, TanStack reduced to Query/Table/Virtual. Supersedes docs/DECISION.md.

projects.name: yolo-next (Next.js fork)
projects.notes: Local fork of vercel/next.js 16.5.0-canary.40 patched for Bun 1.4.4 (package manager, scripts, bun test, bundler: 'bun' on Bun.build, AOT compile), Rust fat-LTO profiles (release-yolo, release-wasm), wasm32 build script and a native WebGPU crate (wgpu 30, napi cdylib). Receipts in docs/yolo/receipts. A real next build with bundler: 'bun' and AOT of the next CLI are not proven; AOT covers a smoke entry only. Transitional layer per yolo-stack ADR 0003; no GitHub fork published.
